ncc.description: Novel Create Center 主入口：一句话入口（识别意图并推荐下一步）、书项目状态、续写恢复、派单与闸门记账。本窗口始终是经理。
ncc.argument_hint: [一句话 | 开新书 | 续写 | 审稿 | 拆书 | continue | status]

ncc-new.description: 开一本新书：S0 立书（选题→三层问答→书魂四问→类型契约，G0 书魂闸）→ S1 立骨（设定 G1 → 大纲 G2）。每个决策点给推荐与备选，停在作者确认点。

ncc-write.description: 写章循环：S2 开篇（黄金三章，G3 开篇闸）或 S3 连载。每章走 上下文包（含读者此刻）→写作→机械检查（含水章）→审稿→修订→复评→落盘回写三本账。
ncc-write.argument_hint: [第N章 | 接着写 | 黄金三章 | 今更3章]

ncc-review.description: 独立审稿与修订闭环：八域累加分制（契约、底蕴两域分别在 M2、M3 启用）、正文证据锚点、SHA 新鲜度绑定、修订后强制复评。审稿者不产稿，修订是显式动作。
ncc-review.argument_hint: [章号或范围 | 全书 | 第3章打回重写]

ncc-deconstruct.description: 按《小说拆分总纲 5.0》拆对标书：章节索引唯一真源、逐章抽取带证据与置信级、事件溯源状态台账，产出喂给设定库与设定词典。
ncc-deconstruct.argument_hint: [原著路径或拆书库目录 | continue]

L0-soul.name: 书魂
L0-soul.content: 书魂四问、类型契约、毒点、终局
L0-soul.change_via: G0-soul 或 G4-volume 的变更提议

L1-skeleton.name: 骨架
L1-skeleton.content: 力量体系、地图序列、主要势力、暗线、各卷走向

world.tool: ncc_state.py fact（知识台账）；状态事件由写手按 book-state.md 格式回写

scout.description: Use this agent when picking a genre, scanning bestseller boards, or generating 2–3 whole-book direction candidates before a book starts. Produces briefing, benchmark list and direction options with a recommendation; never writes settings. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

worldbuilder.description: Use this agent for the world bible, power system, character cards, the setting lexicon and per-book rule/dimension tables. Owns G1 freeze evidence; never outlines plots. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

outliner.description: Use this agent for the three-level outline (master → volume → chapter), the emotion/pulse curve, the 50-chapter rolling window, and registering outline-level promises in the promise ledger. Owns G2 freeze evidence. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

writer.description: Use this agent to draft chapters from an assembled context pack (including the reader-now block): opening chapters and serialized daily chapters. Must establish, advance or pay off at least one promise per chapter and write back the three ledgers; never reviews its own text. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

editor.description: Use this agent to execute explicit revisions from review observations: line-level fixes, de-AI-flavor passes, style anchor alignment. Revision is a separate act from review; must trigger re-review when body text changes. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

continuity.description: Use this agent for continuity audit: setting conflicts, timeline, promise-ledger obligations, knowledge-state leaks (POV discipline), state-event replay, fact-ledger consistency. Produces evidence-cited observations only — never edits manuscripts. Fresh context, no producer memory. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

pulse.description: Use this agent for rhythm and satisfaction review: tension peaks, emotion-point density, hook type and intensity, debt-earn-exceed-witness of payoffs, three-dimension pacing. Scores with body-text anchors only. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

reader.description: Use this agent as a simulated fresh reader for the opening chapters and key chapters: would they keep reading, where do they skim, where do they drop. Blind — no outlines, no settings, no producer context. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

deconstructor.description: Use this agent to deconstruct benchmark novels per the 5.0 framework: chapter index as the single slicing source, evidence-and-confidence-tagged extraction, event-sourced state ledger. Feeds the setting vault and lexicon. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

axioms: 书魂先于情节，情节先于知识。
一切叙事元素都是对读者的承诺。
决定按可逆度分层：越难撤回，越早做、越少人做、闸门越严。
读者始终在场：写每一章前，先知道读者此刻知道什么、在等什么、情绪在哪。
AI 扩展选项，人做选择。
好钢用在刀刃上：文学投入按章节分量分配。
模糊之处给推荐，不把空白题丢给作者。
iron_rules: 写这章的帽不审这章；审稿帽只产带证据的 observation，不改稿。
book.json 与 06-台账 是状态权威；markdown 投影与正文永不回写状态。
修订是显式独立动作；正文 SHA 一变，旧评审即作废，必须复评。
每章动笔前必组装并留档上下文包（含读者此刻），无包不写。
创作决策点（G0–G5）作者拍板；执行阶段（写作/审稿循环）禁停顿——循环内的决策按推荐项执行、记为暂定，单元复盘时集中呈给作者。
宁可记「待定/文本未明确」，不可编造设定；场景用到的学科知识须有出处。
审稿用累加分制：只有引用正文的准则计分，问题不扣分，覆盖率独立；不适用的准则从分母剔除。
每个要作者决定的地方，都给推荐、理由和备选；作者可以先用推荐、以后再改。
